title: Delegate and schedule tasks in Claude Cowork
format_note: Second in a series: two real-use walkthroughs (meeting prep, scheduled task) in a screen recording, bracketed by typographic title cards and a three-card recap.
one_thing: You can steer Claude mid-task and also hand it recurring work, so it does the legwork on your terms.

transcript.voice_style: Calm second-person instruction narrator that reads the on-screen prompts aloud as they are typed and states each benefit once.
transcript.script_shape: Two scenarios, each prompt, work, pivot or edit, handoff line ('the final document is yours to own'); closing two-sentence summary 'steer while they run / run on a schedule'.

structure.frame0: Terracotta field with the full two-line title 'Delegate and schedule tasks in Claude Cowork' in black serif, centred; the subject is the poster (f0001.jpg).
structure.first_3s: Title assembles word by word in under 1.1 s (strip window-01), holds, then a white hand-drawn oval circles 'Delegate' at t=2.0 s; no product UI until 5.4 s.

beats.what: Title card on terracotta; oval swipe on 'Delegate'; words exit one by one.
App home 'Good morning, Katie', then Downloads folder and Review folder in Finder, shown as a cluttered folder of files.
Beige chapter card: 'Using Cowork for multi-step tasks' with terracotta underline on 'multi-step'.
Toggle Gmail, Calendar, Slack connectors; pick Meeting Notes folder; type the long prompt character by character.
Task window: progress checklist ticks off, context panel fills with Slack, Calendar, web search.
User queues 'Please check my email...' mid-task; Claude pivots and builds the doc with email context.
Prep doc ready: biggest wins and watch items; side pane opens the doc and scrolls to blank Action Items.
Second edit: 'Add the pricing update from last Tuesday's Slack thread'; doc regenerates with a Slack thread section.
Beige chapter card: 'Scheduling tasks', underline on 'Scheduling'.
Type the hourly drive-watch prompt; Claude asks one detail, offers alternatives; user adds weekdays 10am-6pm; Schedule button accepted.
Scheduled page, run toast, the finished summary doc, Keep awake toggle, missed-run toasts, history, edit dialog.
Cream recap: three cards (purple, green, terracotta) stagger in, fade, then star + 'Claude Cowork' logo.

hero_moment.what: User's second message lands while the checklist is running and Claude replies 'On it' and carries on: the steer-mid-task claim shown as a state change.

ending.what: Three icon cards 'Work through complex tasks / Schedule recurring tasks / Claude executes the work' then logo lockup; no URL or call to action.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: Title cards and openings cut every 3-5 s; the two walkthroughs are single unbroken screen takes of 111.8 s (43.5% of runtime) and ~62 s, paced by typing and UI state changes. No bursts.

product_ui.notes: Real captured app with demo data. Prompts and message bubbles are legible; progress list, context panel, document pane and history text sit near 8-12 px glyph height at 720p, so phone viewers rely on the narration.

motion.eases: Not measured by easing curve; entries read as quick fade with slight settle, hand-drawn oval and underline draw on like a pen stroke.

good.observation: Full title is on screen at frame 0 and stays readable from t=1 s; the hook states the two subjects (delegate, schedule) immediately.
Prompts are typed in real time and the narration reads them as they appear, so every must-carry instruction reaches the screen verbatim and legibly large.
Mid-task steering is shown rather than described: queue box, message bubble, checklist keeps running, then 'On it' reply.
Chapter cards use one underlined key word in the accent colour and a ground colour change, giving a clear section boundary in about 3 s.
A single punch-in to 150% shows the one detail a viewer would miss, the Keep awake toggle, and the click is seen.
Closing recap pairs three colour-coded cards with hand-drawn icons, one idea each, staggered about 2 s apart, then a still logo.

weak.observation: A 111.8 s single shot (43.5% of runtime) with long typing stretches; the median hold is 1.54 s but the longest is 15.8 s, so the middle is slow.
Side panels, doc text and history at about 8-12 px glyph height are not readable at phone width.
No call to action or URL at the end; only the logo.
Integrated loudness -16.5 LUFS and true peak +0.3 dBTP miss a -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP social master.

rule_candidates.rule: In a tutorial, let a task run in real time, interrupt it once on screen, and show the same window continuing; the interruption is the proof of the claim.
Open a walkthrough with the title card on the same ground colour as the app's surround, so the cut into the UI changes only what is inside the window.
